verdicts.reason: Both put the legal fine print first on the far left, about as large as the subhead, so it competes with the message and the logo is barely visible. In A, the 'Longest Day Sale' ribbon collides with the phone mockup, and the two-line headline plus the subhead are jammed into the full height of the banner. In B, the headline sits cleanly on one line above the subhead, but the ribbon is shrunk and pushed against the bottom edge under the subhead, where it reads as an afterthought. B is slightly cleaner overall.
